def score(item: int, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Score each bin for assigning the current item. Higher score = preferred bin.

    Args:
        item: size of the current item to assign
        bins: remaining capacities of feasible bins (all >= item size)
    Returns:
        scores: priority scores for each bin
    """
    occupancy = item / bins
    scores = np.zeros_like(bins, dtype=np.float64)
    scores[occupancy < 0.3] = np.exp(occupancy[occupancy < 0.3] * 10) - 1
    scores[(occupancy >= 0.3) & (occupancy <= 0.85)] = np.exp((1 - occupancy[(occupancy >= 0.3) & (occupancy <= 0.85)]) * 10)
    scores[occupancy > 0.85] = 10 + (1 / (1 - occupancy[occupancy > 0.85] + 1e-6))
    return scores
genes.thought: The new algorithm introduces exponential bias towards nearly full bins and uses a quadratic penalty for underfilled bins, while maintaining a smooth transition around a mid-range occupancy using a combination of exponential and polynomial functions.
